notes: The harness was counting suites that asserted nothing This is the finding that matters most in this release, and it was found by accident while wiring a new test file. run-all.js executes each suite as node test <file> and reads # pass N. Most suites call node:test's test() at module scope, so N is the assertion count. Six pro forma suites instead built an array of { name, fn } and exported it, expecting some runner to consume it. Nothing did. node test merely imported them, node:test reported the file itself as one passing test, and the battery recorded # pass 1 as a green suite. | suite | as
